title: LabEx course.json schema

id.description: System-assigned LabEx course ID. Omit for a new course until assigned by the backend; preserve the ID of an existing course.

name.description: Learner-facing English course title. Use Title Case while preserving technical names and abbreviations.

description.description: Short English summary of the course subject, intended audience, and outcomes supported by its Labs.

title.description: English SEO title used for the course page in search results.

description.description: English search-result summary describing the course’s actual scope and learning outcomes.

keywords.description: Relevant English SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, not an array or the course tags field.

meta.description: English search-engine metadata for the course page, aligned with the actual course content.

cover.description: URL of the English course cover image. Follow the established course-cover repository URL convention.

level.description: Difficulty of the course as a whole: Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced. Choose according to its prerequisites and learning tasks.

items.description: A course route alias containing lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen.

alias.description: Unique course URL aliases in lowercase kebab-case. Preserve existing aliases when adding or changing routes so established links remain valid.

tags.description: Distinct technology and domain labels supported by substantial course content. Public courses must use public learning path aliases; hidden courses may retain historical technology tags. Do not add labels solely for the runtime environment or assumed prerequisites.

skill_tree.description: Primary learning path alias for the course. Public courses must use a public path alias; hidden courses may retain known historical hidden path aliases. Path membership is configured separately through the path’s levels[].courses IDs.

priority.description: Course display priority in listings; larger values appear earlier.

type.description: Course format: normal for structured teaching, topic-based practice collections, and exams; project for integrated project work. Classify by learning purpose, not directory name, number of Labs, or challenge-only composition.

fee_type.description: Course-level access tier: free or pro; default is free. Referenced Labs have their own independent fee_type settings.

lab_coins.description: Nonnegative course price in LabEx lab coins; applicable when fee_type is pro.

is_orderly.description: Whether learners must complete the course Labs in their configured order; default is false.

hidden.description: Course visibility: true marks a hidden course and false marks a public course; default is false. This does not change the visibility of referenced Labs.

has_cert.description: Whether the course offers a LabEx course certificate; default is false.

show_step_name.description: Whether to display Lab step names for this course; default is false.

show_day_label.description: Whether to prefix Lab names with day labels on the course page, as in X Days courses; default is false.

intro.description: Path to the English Markdown course introduction, relative to the directory containing course.json; normally intro.md.

path.description: Lab reference in organization/repository:repository-relative/path format, resolved to the Lab directory containing index.json. Use a repository path, not a numeric Lab ID.

labs.description: Ordered Lab and Challenge references for a course without named stages. Specify exactly one of labs or stages.

name.description: English name of this stage, displayed in the course syllabus.

path.description: Lab reference in organization/repository:repository-relative/path format, resolved to the Lab directory containing index.json. Use a repository path, not a numeric Lab ID.

labs.description: Ordered Lab and Challenge references belonging to this stage.

stages.description: Ordered named groups of Lab and Challenge references. Use instead of labs when the course has meaningful stages; specify exactly one membership structure.

lang.description: Translation language code: zh, es, fr, de, ja, ru, ko, or pt. English content belongs in the top-level course fields.

name.description: Course title translated into the language identified by lang; preserve technical product names appropriately.

description.description: Localized course summary with the same scope, audience, and outcomes as the English description.

title.description: Localized SEO title for this language’s course page.

description.description: Localized search-result summary preserving the English course’s scope and outcomes.

keywords.description: Relevant localized SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, not an array.

meta.description: Search-engine metadata translated into the language identified by lang.

cover.description: URL of the localized course cover. Artwork may be shared with the English version; follow the established localized cover URL convention.

intro.description: Path to this language’s Markdown course introduction, relative to the directory containing course.json; for example, intro-zh.md.

name.description: Translated name of the corresponding English stage at the same array position.

stages.description: Optional translated stage names corresponding positionally to top-level stages. Keep the same order and stage count; Lab membership remains in the top-level stages.

i18n.description: Localized course metadata and introduction references. English remains in the top-level fields; each entry describes a supported translation.

$comment: Path alias lists are maintained from labex-paths/paths/**/*.yaml, including paths/hidden/. Keep this schema and the labex-cli bundled course_schema.json identical. Public courses use public path aliases; hidden courses retain historical path associations and technology tags.

publicPathAlias.description: Alias from a learning path configuration with is_show: true; used by public courses for skill_tree and tags.
